basePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one finished square constellation illustration for Astune, a refined Korean astronomy reading website. Style/medium: exquisite antique celestial atlas engraving, delicate hand-etched forest-green ink linework and restrained muted antique-gold watercolor accents on warm ivory paper (#f7f5ee). Composition: one coherent centered vignette, full subject visible, generous clean margin on all four sides, square 1024x1024. Subtle scattered small gold stars create a poetic celestial atmosphere; no connecting star lines and no claims of accurate star positions. Elegant, calm, delicate and legible when displayed at 300px. Background paper extends to all edges. No text, no letters, no titles, no labels, no frame, no border, no compass rose unless it is the named subject, no zodiac wheel, no logos, no watermark. One individual constellation illustration, never a collage or contact sheet.
